n: Raspberry Pi Year 8 Vector Graphics unit
t: A six-lesson Year 8 unit on designing vector graphics with Inkscape.
steps: Find the Year 8 Vector Graphics unit on the Raspberry Pi Foundation curriculum site.
Note that the unit is marked archived.
Log in to the curriculum site to download lesson plans and slides.
Ask IT to install Inkscape on each computer.
Try the Get into shapes lesson yourself.
Download the rubric and the summative assessment.
